cases.evidenceSummary: Two distinct callIds used the same command, cwd and input hash. The first real process logged v1 and settled succeeded. A trusted fixture edit changed input.txt hash v1 to v2. The second call was refused as side_effect_replay; the exec effect retained callId of the first call, external kind, no resource keys, and no reRunnable declaration.

test.name: RCD S1B Shell invocation and recovery semantics B01: blocks same successful opaque Shell call after trusted file change and preserves evidence
